g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS static website on CloudFront and S3 with a CodePipeline release

g.title: None.None.Node.28
g.text: AWS WAF filters the request at the edge
CloudFront serves cached pages, fetching misses from S3 through origin access control
If the origin fails, the origin group switches to the replica bucket in a second Region
A developer merges to main on GitHub
CodeBuild builds the site and stores the bundle
deploys it to the staging bucket
and runs browser tests against the staging distribution
Once they pass, it syncs the production bucket and invalidates the CloudFront cache
SNS and AWS Chatbot post the result, and any error-rate alarm, to the team's Slack channel
